column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE CONSUMER AFFAIRS AUTHORITY
ACT, NO. 9 OF 2003

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -

column2: This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Consumer  Affairs
Section 60 of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act,

column1: No.  9  of  2003  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the  “principal
enactment”) is hereby amended as follows :-

column2: by  the  insertion  immediately  after  subsection  (4)
thereof, the following: -

comply with an order made under subsection (5)
of section 20 or acts in contravention of such order
commits an offence and shall on conviction after
trial before a Magistrate, be liable to -
(a)   where such person is not a body corporate, to
a  fine  not  less  than  rupees  one  hundred
thousand  and  not  exceeding  rupees  five

either description for a term not exceeding six
months or to both such fine and imprisonment
